response.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12 GROUP BY res.raceId, r.name ORDER BY avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff of 12 means positionOrder >= 12 (results from 12th place and beyond), interpreting '12 as the cutoff' as the inclusive lower bound where back-of-field results begin

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff of 12 means positionOrder > 12 (results strictly after 12th place, i.e., 13th and beyond)
